items.why: Tempo is speed (e.g. allegro = fast); loudness is described by dynamics.

items.correct: Loud — it is a dynamic marking.
items.misconception: Fast — it is a tempo marking.
items.why: Dynamics (piano/forte) describe volume; tempo terms describe speed.
